<h2>Summarize Matched-Fold sjSDM Decomposition Effects</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Aggregates paired component-removal effects using taxon means within folds
and fold means within repeats for all and eligible taxa.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>summarise_sjsdm_decomposition_effects(data_comparisons = NULL)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_comparisons">data_comparisons</code></td>
<td>
<p>Output from [compare_sjsdm_decomposition_fold_metrics()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Only pairs with status '&quot;ok&quot;' and finite raw effects are summarized.
Negative component effects remain negative at every aggregation level.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A named list containing fold effects, repeat effects, and descriptive
repeat summaries with 95 percent quantile intervals.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
summarise_sjsdm_decomposition_effects(data_comparisons)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>

</main>
